title: 第15章 再遇庞烈第16章 合作夺宝
lines: “哼，冥顽不灵！”
楚峰没有理会帅气青年，扬起手中的长枪，猛然朝着下方三人冲去。
横扫千军！
楚家枪法第一式再度施展而出。
借助高处落下的惯性，再加上造化之力的加持，楚峰这一枪的力道，比起之前再度大上了不少。
“刚才小看了你，现在我们联手，还能怕了你不成！”
三人纷纷出刀抵挡。
铛！
巨大的爆鸣声响起，四人在空中猛烈的碰撞在了一起。
紧接着，三人迅速的倒退了回去，落地之后，三人止不住身形，在地面上划过六道长长的划痕。
而楚峰则是顺势落在了地面之上，随后他再次提枪朝着三人冲了过去。
铛铛铛。
四人很快便战斗在了一起。
楚峰的长枪大开大合，每一招一式，都蕴含着莫大的力量。
三人只感到自己的手臂一阵痛麻，仿佛要被震断了一样。
楚家枪法，总共有三式，是他们楚家先祖在战场之上创造出来的。
这些年，楚峰虽然没有进入宗门。
但是却在自己爷爷那里学了十多年的楚家枪法。
他爷爷作为大夏国的镇边大将军，镇守边关已有三十多年了。
一手楚家枪法，使得早已出神入化。
而楚峰，在家族之中修炼了楚家枪法之后，便前往了边关，在他爷爷的军队里，历练了五年时间。
早已将楚家枪法修炼到了极其高深的境界。
楚峰变换着招式，令三人匆忙招架，一时间竟然逼得三人不停的招架，根本就没有反击的机会。
“这个小子究竟是怎么回事？为何我的元力消耗如此之快！”
领头的那一位血狼帮弟子，越打越心惊。
自己体内的元力竟然比平时消耗得更快。
另外两名血狼帮弟子也是如此。
但是他们却找不到原因。
“真是太好了，没想到吞天造化诀在战斗之中，竟然也能吞噬别人的元力！”
没错。
血狼帮三人体内的元力之所以消耗这么快，便是因为被楚峰吞噬的缘故。
这一切，只有他一个人知道。
“嘶，他们三个联手竟然不敌那小子！”
所有人见状，纷纷倒吸了一口凉气。
这三人的修为可都在楚峰之上啊！
而且，楚峰才刚获得浩阳宗的入门资格，根本就没有进入宗门修炼过。
妥妥的散修一名。
但是面对着血狼帮的弟子，却以弱胜强，这等天赋，难怪能够被浩阳宗长老看中。
“可恶，他的力气怎么这么大？”
血狼帮三人咬牙切齿。
本以为是一个软柿子，却没想到，竟然如此难啃。
content_en:
"Huh, stubborn!"
Chu Feng ignored the handsome young man, raised the spear in his hand, and suddenly rushed towards the three people below.
Sweeping thousands of armies!
The first form of the Chu family's marksmanship was used again.
With the help of the inertia of falling from a high place and the blessing of the power of creation, the force of Chu Feng's shot was much greater than before.
"I underestimated you just now, but now that we have joined forces, we can still be afraid of you!"
The three of them drew their swords to resist.
clang!
A huge explosion sounded, and the four people collided violently in the air.
Immediately afterwards, the three of them quickly fell back. After landing, the three of them could not stop themselves and drew six long scratches on the ground.
Chu Feng landed on the ground, and then he raised his gun again and rushed towards the three of them.
Clang clang clang.
The four of them soon fought together.
Chu Feng's spear was opened and closed, and every move contained great power.
The three of them felt a numbness in their arms, as if they were about to be broken.
There are three styles of Chu family's marksmanship, which were created by their ancestors of the Chu family on the battlefield.
In these years, although Chu Feng has not entered the sect.
But he learned the Chu family's marksmanship from his grandfather for more than ten years.
His grandfather, as the Great Xia Kingdom's border general, had been guarding the border for more than thirty years.
The Chu family's marksmanship has already reached perfection.
As for Chu Feng, after practicing the Chu family's marksmanship in his family, he went to the border and practiced in his grandfather's army for five years.
The Chu family's marksmanship has long been cultivated to an extremely advanced level.
Chu Feng changed his moves, causing the three of them to parry hurriedly. For a moment, they were forced to keep parrying, without any chance of counterattack.
"What's going on with this kid? Why is my energy consumed so quickly!"
The leading disciple of the Blood Wolf Gang became more and more frightened as he fought.
The energy in his body was actually consumed faster than usual.
The same goes for the other two Blood Wolf Gang disciples.
But they couldn't find the reason.
"That's great. I didn't expect the Heaven-Swallowing Creation Technique to be able to swallow other people's energy during battle!"
That's right.
The reason why the Yuan Power in the bodies of the three members of the Blood Wolf Gang was consumed so quickly was because they were devoured by Chu Feng.
He is the only one who knows all this.
"Hiss, the three of them joined forces and were defeated by that kid!"
Everyone gasped when they saw this.
The cultivation levels of these three people are all above Chu Feng!
Moreover, Chu Feng had just obtained the entry qualification of Haoyang Sect and had never entered the sect to practice at all.
A proper casual cultivator.
But facing the disciples of the Blood Wolf Gang, the weak defeated the strong. With such a talent, it is no wonder that the elders of the Haoyang Sect took notice.
"Damn it, why is he so strong?"
The three members of the Blood Wolf Gang gritted their teeth.
I thought it was a soft persimmon, but I didn't expect it to be so difficult to chew.
